privacy: We collect only what we need to process your order: your name, email, phone number, delivery address and payment proof.
Passwords are never stored in plain text. They are hashed, so nobody at the shop can read them.
Transaction IDs and payment screenshots are used only to confirm your Telebirr payment, and are visible only to you and the shop admin.
We do not sell your personal data. We share it only when needed to deliver your order or when the law requires it.
You can update your details at any time, or ask us to delete your account through the support email in the footer.
